text.en:
EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 1019 March 18, 1985
Subject Matter : Reorganizing the tax collection and assessment machinery in the Provinces, Municipalities
and Cities and other purposes suspending the effectivity of Real Property Tax increase to January 1, 1988
instead of January 1, 1985.
Date of Effectivity : March 18, 1985
